# `debug` operations

10 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### debug.start

Start debugger. writes.

Start or reuse a persistent JDWP Android/JVM, native Android LLDB, or local LLDB Swift/native debug session. Android sessions exclusively own their device until disconnected.

- `backend` string, required (one of jdwp, lldb, android-lldb)
- `device` string
- `bundle_id` string
- `launch` boolean (default true): JDWP: restart and wait for the debugger. Android LLDB: launch only if the app is not already running, then attach. Existing native app processes are preserved.
- `port` integer (1 to 65535)
- `adapter` string
- `program` string: Local executable, or matching unstripped ELF library for android-lldb.
- `cwd` string
- `args` array of string (up to 100 items)
- `pid` integer (1 to 2147483647)
- `stop_on_entry` boolean (default true)
- `environment` object
- `source_map` array of array (up to 100 items)
- `symbol_paths` array of string (up to 20 items): Additional local directories containing matching unstripped Android native libraries.

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.start '{"backend":"jdwp"}'
```

### debug.list

Debug sessions. read-only, idempotent.

List persistent debug sessions and detect exited workers.

No arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.list
```

### debug.state

Debugger status. read-only, idempotent.

Read current stop state, target and active thread.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.state '{"session":"<session>"}'
```

### debug.events

Debugger events. read-only, idempotent.

Read bounded, cursor-based debugger events.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `after` integer (0 to 9007199254740991; default 0)
- `limit` integer (1 to 1000; default 100)

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.events '{"session":"<session>"}'
```

### debug.breakpoints

Set breakpoints. writes.

Replace breakpoints in a Java/Kotlin class name (JDWP) or absolute source file (LLDB); unloaded classes remain pending until prepared.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `source` string, required (non-empty)
- `lines` array of integer, required (up to 200 items)

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.breakpoints '{"session":"<session>","source":"<source>","lines":[1]}'
```

### debug.threads

Read threads. read-only, idempotent.

Read target threads and identifiers.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)

```sh

```

### debug.stack

Read call stack. read-only, idempotent.

Read source frames for a stopped thread.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `thread_id` string
- `limit` integer (1 to 100; default 30)

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.stack '{"session":"<session>"}'
```

### debug.variables

Read variables. read-only, idempotent.

Read frame locals (JDWP), frame scopes (LLDB), or expand an object/scope reference.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `thread_id` string
- `frame_id` string
- `reference` string
- `start` integer (0 to 100000; default 0)
- `count` integer (1 to 1000; default 100)

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.variables '{"session":"<session>"}'
```

### debug.evaluate

Evaluate expression. writes.

LLDB evaluates expressions; JDWP resolves a local variable or dotted field path without executing target methods.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `expression` string, required (non-empty, up to 10000 characters)
- `thread_id` string
- `frame_id` string

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.evaluate '{"session":"<session>","expression":"<expression>"}'
```

### debug.control

Control debugger. writes.

Pause, continue, step or detach. Disconnect resumes the target without terminating it.

- `session` string, required (matching `[a-f0-9]{32}`)
- `action` string, required (one of pause, continue, next, stepIn, stepOut, disconnect)
- `thread_id` string

```sh
tomaccoctl call debug.control '{"session":"<session>","action":"pause"}'
```
